content_sections.heading: Nainital Bank HR Advisor Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the minimum educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: About Nainital Bank
content_sections.text: The Nainital Bank Limited describes itself as a private sector scheduled commercial bank that is around a century old, established in 1922 by Bharat Ratna Late Pt. Govind Ballabh Pant and a few other prominent personalities of Nainital. It has 3 Regional Offices, at Haldwani, Dehradun and Noida. Its 178 branches are spread across Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Haryana and Rajasthan.

content_sections.heading: Nainital Bank HR Advisor Vacancy Details 2026

rows.pay: Lump sum Rs. 100,000 per month; maximum offered Rs. 12.00 lakh per annum

content_sections.heading: Nainital Bank HR Advisor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Minimum 50 years and maximum 65 years as on 31 October 2026. Experience: Candidates must meet both of these conditions: Superannuated, retired or VRS opted in Grade/Scale of AGM and above, having worked in any public sector bank. Understanding of labour laws, HR and IR issues, organizational policies and people management. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: HR Advisor Job Profile
content_sections.text: Advise management on HR policies, automation and compliance. Support strategic workforce planning, capacity building and succession planning of the Bank. Handle training assessment, HR technology and analytics. Mentor and guide the existing HR team. Assist in disciplinary, legal and employee relations matters. Advise on IR issues, deployment, employee engagement and welfare. Ensure fair treatment of staff in line with employment laws and company policy. Interpret and enforce HR policies and procedures. Assist in drafting and updating HR policies and employee handbooks. Assist in managing performance review cycles. Advise managers on performance improvement plans and goal setting. Support succession planning and talent management initiatives. Take up any other HR matters related to the Bank assigned from time to time.

rows.event: Last date to email the application

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience. The requisite number of shortlisted candidates are called for interview. Final selection is made on the Personal Interview. Satisfying the eligibility norms alone does not entitle a candidate to an interview call. The Bank may reject any application not suitable to its requirement without assigning a reason, and may call only the requisite number of eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contract period: 1 year, extendable up to 3 years. Termination: The Bank may terminate the contract by one month's notice or compensation in lieu thereof during the contractual period. Place of posting: The Bank's Head Office, Nainital, or any other place decided by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nainital Bank HR Advisor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed format given below the notification. Paste a recent photograph at the appropriate place. Sign the application. Email the application with the prescribed documents to [email protected] on or before the closing date. Incomplete and illegible applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Nainital Bank HR Advisor post?
faq.answer: The post is open to officers who superannuated, retired or opted for VRS in Grade/Scale of AGM and above after working in any public sector bank.

faq.question: Q2. What is the most the Bank will pay an HR Advisor?
faq.answer: The maximum offered is Rs. 12.00 lakh per annum, paid as a monthly lump sum.

faq.question: Q3. Can the contract last longer than one year?
faq.answer: Yes. The initial 1-year contract can be extended up to 3 years.

faq.question: Q4. Will every eligible applicant get an interview?
faq.answer: No. The Bank will call only the requisite number of shortlisted candidates, based on eligibility and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. Which subjects should an applicant understand for this post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for an understanding of labour laws, HR and IR issues, organizational policies and people management.

faq.question: Q6. Will the post always be based in Nainital?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The post is at the Head Office in Nainital, but the Bank can decide on another place.

faq.question: Q7. Can the Bank cancel this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
